sources.excerpt: The Wampler Black '65 Limited Edition is a pedal designed to emulate the iconic "blackface" American amplifiers of the 1960s, providing a faithful reproduction of their classic tones. This limited edition pedal offers nuanced grit and flexibility for any rig. What Wampler Pedals say about the Black ’65 Limited Edition There was something magical about certain amps from the 1960s, amps that have become to be known as the "blackface" or "black panel" style of amplifiers from a certain legendary American guitar and amplifier company. With such a rich legacy of tone to follow, Grand Pappy BDub’s take on the American-voiced amps of that period was turned into the legendary Black ‘65 Pedal. Through a clean amp, this pedal offers a faithful reproduction of the tones Brian loved from this classic period, and it is also flexible enough to add a new level of nuanced grit to your existing rig. This is a limited edition pedal and only available to purchase online here from Wamplerpedals.com. Once they’re gone, they’re gone! www.wamplerpedals.com What guitarists say... Guitarists rave about the Black '65, with some calling it the best pedal they've ever played. Users frequently praise its fantastic sound, often pairing it with amps like the Fender Tonemaster Princeton Reverb for exceptional results.
